column2: question
What is always coming but never arrives?
Feed me and I live, give me drink and I die. What am I?
What runs all around a backyard yet never moves?
The more you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with wind. What am I?
The more of this there is, the less you see. What is it?
What has to be broken before you can use it?
I have keys but no locks. I have space but no room. You can enter, but you cannot go outside. What am I?
What gets wetter the more it dries?
I am always in front of you but can never be seen. What am I?
What has a neck but no head?
What can travel around the world while staying in a corner?
I have branches, but no fruit, trunk or leaves. What am I?
What is full of holes but still holds water?
What word is spelled incorrectly in every dictionary?
I am taken from a mine and shut up in a wooden case, from which I am never released, and yet I am used by almost everyone. What am I?
The person who makes it sells it. The person who buys it never uses it. What is it?
I have cities, but no houses. I have mountains, but no trees. I have water, but no fish. What am I?
What can fill a room but takes up no space?
If you drop me I am sure to crack, but give me a smile and I will smile back. What am I?
